publisher: Northumberland County Council / HM Revenue & Customs
evidence_slice: Northumberland County Council's Investment Zones dataset, updated 20 August 2026 and licensed under the UK Open Government Licence, states that Investment Zones are intended to catalyse high-potential industry clusters, increase inward investment and create jobs on designated sites. The public FeatureServer 'Investment_Zones' exposes an Investment Zones polygon layer in British National Grid EPSG:27700. HM Revenue & Customs identifies Blyth as one of the two tax sites within the North East Investment Zone, and the 2024 designation regulations name the area 'Blyth Tax Site' with designation effective 8 April 2024.

field_evidence.policy_purpose: catalyse high-potential industry clusters, increase inward investment and create jobs

binding_method: legally designated Investment Zone special tax site plus authority-hosted public polygon layer; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
